title: Agent
description: A Dialogflow CX agent resource representing a conversational virtual agent.

defaultLanguageCode.description: Default language of the agent as a BCP-47 language tag.

supportedLanguageCodes.description: List of additional supported language codes.

timeZone.description: Time zone of the agent from the IANA time zone database.

startFlow.description: Name of the start flow in the agent.

securitySettings.description: Name of the security settings resource.

enableStackdriverLogging.description: Whether to enable Stackdriver logging for the agent.

enableSpellCorrection.description: Whether to enable spell correction for the agent.

locked.description: Whether the agent is locked for changes.
